messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 PAGER: P1 — inference latency spike detected in us-east-1. Alerting primary on-call @jordan and SRE rotation. War room: https://meet.redwood/w/eq7k2 · Pager link: https://pager.redwood/alerts/1723456789
jordan: ack, joining war room now. taking initial ownership for mitigation and customer comms.
maria: joining. I'll pull autoscaler + kvcache dashboards, also checking model-variant fallbacks.
lee: oncall infra here — I see a sudden increase in avg token latency and queue length on pool-inference-12. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/inf/us-east?panel=latency
safiya: product-support: flagging customer impact — a few large customers reporting 5xx and slow responses on chat endpoints. Drafting a short note for status page.
jordan: quick checklist: 1) confirm blast radius, 2) enable fallback routing to cheaper variant, 3) scale reserve if needed, 4) prepare status update draft. I'll run routing changes.
maria: blast radius: metrics show ~12% of traffic from us-east routes hitting >5x latency for chat-gen (seq len ~1024). Embedding/other endpoints unaffected.
dave: ops-manager here — please confirm if Dedicated customers are impacted or only hosted tier? need list for CS.
safiya: early triage: mix of hosted API tenants + 2 Dedicated customers in us-east experiencing degraded throughput. CS already reaching out.
lee: trying a controlled traffic shift to model-variant v2-quant-fallback for low-latency path, routing rule applied to 10% of traffic now.
jordan: applied routing rule to 30% -> monitoring. If error rate drops on shifted traffic, we'll ramp.
maria: logs show increased KV cache eviction rate on pool-inference-12 which aligns with latency. I'll try increasing kv-cache limit for the pool.
lee: kv-cache limit bumped to 1.5x on the affected nodes. `kubectl -n inference set env deployment/inference-worker KV_CACHE_MAX=1.5`
safiya: status page draft suggestion (short):
```
Redwood Inference is investigating increased latency and partial errors for text generation in US-East. Some customers may experience degraded performance. We are actively mitigating; next update in 15-30 minutes.
```
jordan: good. I'll post that once we validate fallback results. Also preparing a short customer email template for CS: "We're investigating increased latency... we will update..."
dave: please tag Dedicated customer IDs for follow-up post-mitigation. Also escalate to Eng-SRE if we don't see improvement in 20m.
maria: monitoring: shifted traffic to fallback variant shows 60% lower error rate so far. kv-cache bump reduced eviction spikes.
lee: continuing to scale a few more nodes in the pool as precaution — autoscaler policy manually bumped to min+2.
jordan: confirming on-call handoff protocol: I'm owner for incident and will coordinate postmortem. maria/lee are mitigation leads. safiya with customer comms. dave, you're on executive updates.
safiya: noted. drafting quick status page now and pinging CS with email template.
incident-bot: reminder: escalate to pager rotation if unresolved after 20 minutes.
jordan: we'll reassess at +20m; if metrics stay improved, we'll keep ramping down fallback and restore normal routing. If not, we'll enact emergency reserve capacity.
maria: capturing initial signals and config changes in the war room notes. will add links to the runbook steps used.
lee: all mitigation steps logged. continuing to watch. thanks team :thumbsup:
